details: The crypto market experienced a downturn on October 22, 2026, with total market capitalization losing 2.64%. Bitcoin traded around $82,690, having reached an overnight high of $84,808 before facing renewed selling pressure. This decline contributed to Bitcoin's dominance rising to 59.53% as altcoins generally saw larger losses.
title: Crypto Market Slides as Bitcoin Holds Above $82,000 Amid Broader Sell-off

details: TRON solidified its position as a leading blockchain for stablecoin settlement in Q3 2026, processing $2.21 trillion in stablecoins and capturing approximately 73% of the total transfer volume. USDT on TRON also reached an all-time high of over $92.7 billion. The network further saw the debut of the first U.S. spot staked TRX exchange-traded fund (ETF).
title: TRON Dominates Stablecoin Settlement, Launches First TRX ETF

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced a significant rebound, attracting about $1.07 billion across three trading sessions, thereby reversing net withdrawals seen earlier in October. This inflow streak included $524.8 million on Wednesday, adding to the cumulative monthly inflows of approximately $460 million.
title: Bitcoin ETFs Attract $1.07 Billion in Three Days, Reversing October Losses

details: Remittix is set to significantly expand its PayFi ecosystem by integrating 41 new fiat currencies, aiming to enhance crypto-to-bank and bank-to-crypto transactions globally. The project has raised $33 million towards a $36 million hard cap, with its RTX token launching on November 24, 2026. This expansion seeks to broaden its international market relevance.
title: Remittix to Expand PayFi with 41 New Fiat Currencies

details: THORChain has planned its V3.21 network upgrade for October 23, 2026. This upgrade aims to address and restore functionality for Solana and Zcash trading, alongside strengthening the network's application layer, signaling ongoing development and maintenance efforts.
title: THORChain Schedules October 23 Upgrade for Solana & Zcash Fixes

details: The Central Bank of Ireland has announced an enforcement action against Coinbase Ireland, fining the exchange $3.6 million for failures related to safeguarding user funds and providing adequate oversight between 2020 and 2025. Coinbase Ireland has reportedly agreed with the facts of the enforcement action.
title: Coinbase Ireland Fined $3.6M for Oversight, Safeguard Failures

details: Zcash (ZEC) price sustained a 15% gain this week, trading above $1,300 on October 22, 2026, driven by a return of institutional and retail interest. Grayscale's ZEC-focused ETF recorded over $15 million in inflows on Wednesday, marking a 30-day high and contributing to a rise in ZEC futures Open Interest to $2.89 billion.
title: Zcash Reclaims $1,300 with Strong ETF Inflows
